headline: Databases and tools extend AlphaFold-era modeling of complexes, RNA, and ligands
label: Biomolecular Structure Prediction Databases
summary: Recent preprints and publications release curated RNA, protein-complex, and ligand-interaction resources alongside AlphaFold-based modeling tools.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational infrastructure linking experimental macromolecular structures to prediction, interaction analysis, and annotation. Distance-AF Multimer adds user-defined residue-pair distance constraints to AlphaFold-Multimer docking with iterative refinement, while HDOCK-Multimer combines docking with combinatorial assembly and is reported to outperform AlphaFold3 and CombFold. MODNAP benchmarks AlphaFold 3 on 1039 nucleic acid and nucleic acid-protein complexes containing ribose-modified nucleotides. SMARTFlexDB pairs apo and holo RNA structures to capture conformational change and small-molecule recognition, and NCI-Profiler detects nine non-covalent interaction types from PDB and mmCIF files. RNAffinityDB, DRAMP 5.0, and CLEAN extend curated resources to binding affinities, sequence-structure encoding, and enzyme function coverage. The distinctive elements are constraint-guided complex modeling and explicit RNA and modified-nucleotide coverage.
